# CardGoal

Figma: [07b. CardGoal](https://www.figma.com/design/a7Z956YZy9n6f9uz5DK16Y?node-id=69-943) · Family: 07 Cards & Lists · Status: wip · Version 2.0.0 · Updated 2026-01-01

The investment-goal system: a pre-activation CTA (GoalActivate) and an active progress tracker (GoalTracker) with milestone phase rows. LTR/RTL, fully tokenized, composed from atoms.

## Guide from the doc page

### Overview

CardGoal helps a user set and track an investment goal. Before activation it shows GoalActivate - a CTA to determine a goal. After activation it shows GoalTracker - milestone phase rows (achieved/pending) with a radial ring and a running total. Both ship LTR + RTL.

### Atomic architecture

Both organisms are composed from atoms - Goal Headline, Amount, Illustration, PhaseRow (a molecule wrapping RadialProgress) and Summary - plus the shared RadialProgress, Button and ProgressBar. No raw shapes.

Headline

Amount

Illustration

PhaseRow

Summary

RadialProgress

Button

ProgressBar

### Components

Two organisms cover the goal lifecycle: GoalActivate (pre-activation CTA) and GoalTracker (active progress).

GoalActivate

GoalTracker

### Phases

GoalActivate has three phases: Begining (set a goal), Started (finish setup, shows progress), Static (informational).

Begining

Started

Static

### States

GoalTracker shows Active (a mix of achieved + pending milestones) and Complete (all achieved). PhaseRow drives each row: Achieved (green) / Pending (gray).

Tracker · Overachieved

Tracker · Complete

Tracker · Active

Tracker · Early

Row · 50%

Row · 0%

### Direction - LTR & RTL

Both organisms mirror fully: layout flips, text right-aligns, Arabic content, the ring moves to the leading edge and the chevron points inward.

CTA · LTR

CTA · RTL

Tracker · LTR

Tracker · RTL

### Code examples

Flutter usage of both organisms.

### GoalActivate (CTA)

```dart
SafqahGoalActivate(
  phase: GoalPhase.begining,
  title: 'Determine your investment goal',
  body: 'Pick a target and we’ll map the deals.',
  ctaLabel: 'Set your goals',
  onSetGoal: () => context.push('/goal/new'),
)
```

### GoalTracker (active)

```dart
SafqahGoalTracker(
  title: 'Your investment goal',
  total: goal.achievedTotal,
  milestones: goal.milestones.map((m) => Milestone(
    label: m.month,
    amount: m.amount,
    percent: m.percent,
    achieved: m.isAchieved,
  )).toList(),
)
```

### Usage - Do & Don’t

Do

Show GoalActivate before a goal exists, and GoalTracker once the user has activated one.

Don’t

Don’t render GoalTracker with zero milestones - fall back to GoalActivate.

Do

Lead with the nearest milestone to leverage the goal-gradient effect.

Don’t

Don’t rely on green-vs-grey alone - keep the % and status text on every row.
